title: Anjac Health & Beauty unveils dedicated offering for GLP-1 users
summary: The French industrial group specializing in the formulation, manufacturing and packaging of products for the healthcare, beauty and food supplement sectors, is launching a new platform dedicated to supporting individuals on GLP-1 treatments. At CPHI Milan, taking place from 6 to 8 October 2026, Anjac Health & Beauty is unveiling a range of solutions designed to address the key needs associated with these treatments and support patients throughout their care journey.
